problems.explain: With the base 9, the height is 22 sin 22°, so the area is ½ × 9 × 22 × sin 22° ≈ 37.0861, which is 37.1 to 1 decimal place. (½ × 9 × 22 = 99 is the area only when C is 90°; the angle must be the one between the two sides.) So 37.1 ft².
